schemaChange: NONE — pure logic over existing proof_risk_adjudications records
trainingReclassified: ESCALATE_FOR_TRAINING now KEEPS the finding visible (action item), no longer clears

suppressionModel.rule: isFindingSuppressed — suppress only when EVERY supporting proof of a signal is cleared for its own source type
suppressionModel.newEvidence: a new supporting proof is not in the cleared set -> the signal re-surfaces (never a permanent hide)
suppressionModel.perSourceScope: clearing one source never eases another

perSourceBehavior.REUSED_HASH_FINDING: cleared proofIds filtered from findings + anti-gaming/credibility feed; new reused proof re-surfaces
perSourceBehavior.ANTI_GAMING_SIGNAL: cleared signal dropped from topGamingSignal; confirm/require-fresh stay
perSourceBehavior.CREDIBILITY_CONCERN: cleared concern dropped from topCredibilityConcern; confirm/inconclusive stay
perSourceBehavior.PROOF_DISPUTE: cleared dispute dropped from dispute-derived profit/constraint (reduces owner-review burden); PROOF_OUTCOME_INTEGRITY + proof.disputed audit NEVER erased

ownerNowView.proofRiskAdjudicationSummary: active/cleared/inconclusive counts, latest decisions, top active action

sloImpact.ANTI_GAMING_RISK: eases only when active top gaming signal cleared and no other evidence
sloImpact.EVIDENCE_CREDIBILITY_RISK: eases only when active top credibility concern cleared and no other evidence
sloImpact.PROOF_OUTCOME_INTEGRITY: audit-derived; never eased by a dispute adjudication

safety.crossWorkspaceIsolation: per-workspace adjudications; clean workspace no state (tested)

remaining: per-proof evidence lists for the remaining gaming/credibility signal types (self-review, rubber-stamp) so they can be suppressed
owner UI for the adjudication queue
